name: Vibe Video
tagline: AI video agent that generates, finds and edits your footage
description: Describe the video and add raw clips, screen recordings or a logo. The agent plans shots, generates missing ones with Seedance 2, finds stock b-roll and edits everything into one cut. You approve a shot plan and 10-second preview before the full render. Paid with credits, no free tier; full agent workflow opening in stages.
